constraints.name: adjacency_definition
constraints.description: Seats in the airplane are arranged in n rows of 8 seats each. Two seats are neighbor if they are in the same row and belong to seat index sets {1,2}, {3,4}, {4,5}, {5,6}, or {7,8}.

constraints.name: no_cross_group_adjacency
constraints.description: No two soldiers from different groups are allowed to sit on neighboring seats.
constraints.formal: If soldier p from group i sits on seat s and soldier q from group j (i≠j) sits on seat t, then s and t cannot be neighbors.

constraints.name: full_placement
constraints.description: All soldiers from all groups must be placed on the airplane, i.e., exactly a_i seats assigned to group i.
constraints.formal: For each group i, the number of occupied seats by group i equals a_i.

constraints.name: seat_capacity_one
constraints.description: Each seat can hold at most one soldier.
constraints.formal: For each seat, at most one soldier is placed.
